name: weepark
description: WeePark parking platform — root scripts for regression and validation

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').includes('pnpm')){console.error('This repo uses pnpm. Run: pnpm install');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter weepark-backend test && pnpm --filter weepark-frontend test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter weepark-backend test:unit && pnpm --filter weepark-frontend test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: echo 'Frontend E2E skipped while the UI is being redesigned' && exit 0
scripts.validate:backend: pnpm --filter weepark-backend typecheck && pnpm --filter weepark-backend lint && pnpm --filter weepark-backend test && pnpm --filter weepark-backend build
scripts.validate:frontend: pnpm --filter weepark-frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter weepark-frontend lint && pnpm --filter weepark-frontend test && pnpm --filter weepark-frontend build
